faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GBPUAT Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the GBPUAT Project Assistant recruitment is 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant post will receive a salary of Rs. 22000 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a BSc Ag or BSc ZBC degree to be eligible for the Project Assistant position.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the GBPUAT Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 56/Agr./2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Assistant post is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the GBPUAT located?
faq.answer: G. B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology is located in Pantnagar, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 263145.
